editorial: Today, security vulnerabilities and uncensored trends in artificial intelligence models are coming to the forefront in software development processes. While data breaches on the Lovable platform open up a debate on application security, next-generation visual and language models on Hugging Face are pushing technical capacity.

items.title: backnotprop/plannotator
items.summary: Developed with TypeScript, plannotator offers a workspace that manages planning, code review, and feedback processes for artificial intelligence agents. It allows users to organize their interactions with agents and share them within the team.

snapshot.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

items.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
items.summary: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src is a resource repository that aims to keep coding agents aligned with current web development standards and best practices. The project includes the code and documentation necessary for the creation, calibration, and evaluation of this content.

snapshot.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices. This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents.

items.title: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
items.summary: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills is an artificial intelligence coding tool that offers functions such as market analysis, technical charts, economic calendars, and strategy development for stock investors and traders. Prepared in the Python language, this project runs on Claude Code and helps with processing financial data and managing trading processes.

snapshot.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.

items.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
items.summary: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp allows coding agents (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, or Copilot) to inspect and control a live Chrome browser. Offered as a Model Context Protocol server and command-line interface, this tool provides AI-powered assistants with full access to browser tools for debugging and performance analysis.

snapshot.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents. Chrome DevTools for agents (chrome-devtools-mcp) lets your coding agent (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It is available as a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and as a CLI. Both give your AI coding assistant access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis.

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.summary: Developed by Alibaba, open-code-review is a hybrid tool that combines deterministic pipelines with large language models (LLM) to automate code review processes. Containing multilingual rules for software security and bug detection, this system aims to improve code quality by providing line-level comments.

snapshot.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

items.title: QwenLM/qwen-code
items.summary: QwenLM/qwen-code is an open-source coding artificial intelligence agent that works in terminal, editor, desktop, and browser environments. Developed with the TypeScript language, this tool aims to assist the user in software development processes.

snapshot.description: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal. The open-source AI coding agent for your terminal, editor, desktop, browser, and chat.

items.title: dream-num/univer
items.summary: Univer offers an open-source software development kit (SDK) that allows developers to build their own office software and integrate features such as editing and calculation into their products. This tool provides an extensible infrastructure that supports collaboration and file processing for both humans and artificial intelligence agents.

snapshot.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.

items.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
items.summary: AG-UI is an open-source, event-based communication protocol that connects artificial intelligence agents to user interfaces. It simplifies application integrations by enabling developers to establish a standard data flow between AI agents and user interfaces.

snapshot.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications. AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications. Built for simplicity and flexibility, it enables seamless integration between AI agents, real time user context, and user interfaces.

items.title: ashhart/TensorFold
items.summary: ashhart/TensorFold offers an inference engine with Metal, CUDA, and Vulkan support for large language models (LLM). Developed with the Zig programming language, this tool allows for running models directly on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA graphics processors without the need for a Python or MLX installation.

snapshot.description: LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan. TensorFold serves language models from a Zig binary on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs. The engine reads checkpoints, tokenizes requests and runs Metal or CUDA kernels directly. Serving needs no Python or MLX installation.

items.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman
items.summary: JuliusBrussee/caveman is a proxy and capability package developed for coding artificial intelligence agents. It aims to reduce the amount of tokens used by 65 percent by simplifying communication.

snapshot.description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick. Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.

items.title: louislam/uptime-kuma
items.summary: Uptime Kuma is a visual-focused monitoring tool that you can host on your own server, used to track the uptime of servers and services. Developed in the JavaScript language, this software offers a simple interface for users who want to easily track system statuses.

snapshot.description: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool. Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use self-hosted monitoring tool.

items.title: we-promise/sure
items.summary: Sure, developed with the Ruby language, is an application that aims to offer personal finance and asset management for everyone. Inspired by features previously developed by the team behind the abandoned project Maybe Finance, this platform allows users to manage their financial data.

snapshot.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone). The Maybe Finance (archived/abandoned repo) team spent most of 2021–2022 building a full-featured personal finance and wealth management app. It even included an “Ask an Advisor” feature that connected users with a real CFP/CFA — all included with your subscription.

items.title: Tencent/LoopForge
items.summary: LoopForge, developed by Tencent, is a self-hosted workflow tool used to manage the delivery processes of coding agents. It supports local coding assistant processes by orchestrating software such as CodeBuddy, Codex, and Claude Code with scripts and human approval mechanisms.

snapshot.description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.

items.title: Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo
items.summary: Veyra-NRVideo is an advanced Windows video player that offers real-time preview for videos and capture card sources. The tool aims to enhance the visual experience by using AI-powered super resolution and image enhancement technologies.

snapshot.description: Bring PS5 GTA6 to 120FPS with DLSS 5. An advanced Windows video player and capture enhancement tool featuring real-time preview for videos, images, and capture card sources. Combine AI-powered Super Resolution, DLSS5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to deliver a next-generation visual experience.

items.title: martin-olivier/airgorah
items.summary: Airgorah, developed with the Rust language, is software used to audit wireless network security. It offers the ability to monitor nearby network traffic, detect devices connected to access points, and perform security tests such as password cracking.

snapshot.description: A WiFi security auditing software. Airgorah is a WiFi security auditing software that can capture nearby WiFi traffic, discover clients connected to access points, perform deauthentication attacks, capture handshakes and PMKIDs, and crack the password of access points.

items.title: SpaceX catches the Starship to end Flight 15
items.summary: SpaceX successfully recovered the first stage of the rocket during Starship flight 15 by catching it with the arms on the launch tower. This method represents a technical milestone developed to increase the reusability of rocket components.

snapshot.description: https://x.com/SpaceX/status/2121316300702056595https://youtu.be/jHlpfNSpBmw?t=3233

items.title: Lovable apps expose passport details and more than 200K private messages
items.summary: An analysis of applications developed on the Lovable platform revealed that over 200,000 private messages and sensitive data such as passport information were accessible without requiring a login. The research shows that serious security vulnerabilities exist in over 159,000 projects examined.

snapshot.description: Our analysis of 159,041 Lovable projects reveals many cases where sensitive data was accessible without logging in.

items.title: Why get an expensive Pi when I have an old phone?
items.summary: The fact that old smartphones contain components like cameras, batteries, and mobile data makes them a preferable hardware alternative to single-board computers like Raspberry Pi. This approach allows for the repurposing of existing devices, eliminating the need to purchase additional peripherals.

snapshot.description: A second-hand smartphone already has the camera, GPS, storage, battery and mobile data I was assembling around a Raspberry Pi.

items.title: KDE: The documentary [video]
items.summary: KDE: The Documentary tells the story of the open-source community that has been developing alternatives to proprietary desktop environments like Windows since 1996. The documentary covers the founding and development process of one of the pioneering communities in the free software world.

snapshot.description: KDE: The Documentary tells the story of the pioneering open source community that gave computer users a free and open alternative to proprietary desktops like Windows. The story starts in 1996, whe...

items.title: Nvidia deliberately kept GPU prices high through circular financing deals
items.summary: It is alleged that Nvidia uses circular financing deals to keep graphics processing unit (GPU) prices high. The company, which is claimed to affect market balance with this method, is accused of manipulating sales processes with this strategy.

items.title: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic
items.summary: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic, shared on Hugging Face, is an AI model focused on text generation. The developer also offers the xtools-at/Qwen3.5-9B-DeepThought-STEM option, a science-focused fine-tuning study on which this model is based, for users to examine.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Also check out DeepThought, my science finetune based on this model: xtools-at/Qwen3.5-9B-DeepThought-STEM

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image
items.summary: MiniMax-H3-Image, offered by MiniMaxAI, is an AI model that performs text-to-image conversions. It provides API (a digital bridge that allows two different software programs to communicate with each other) documentation containing image editing, text-to-image conversion, and prompt expansion features for software developers to integrate into their systems.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. API docs: - Text-to-image: EN-docs, CN-docs - Image editing: EN-docs, CN-docs - Prompt expansion: EN-docs, CN-docs

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, published on Hugging Face, is an AI model that processes visual and text inputs to produce text output. It has been released as the most capable version of the Qwen open model family to date.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Following the widespread community adoption of the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 series, we are pleased to introduce Qwen3.8, the most capable generation in the Qwen open-model family to date.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
items.summary: LTX-2.5, developed by Lightricks, is an image-to-video artificial intelligence model that transforms images into moving videos. Shared on the Hugging Face platform, this model allows users to convert their static content into video format.

snapshot.description: image-to-video model

items.title: DavidAU/Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion-735-882-Heretic-Uncensored-NEO-CODER-MAX-MTP-GGUF
items.summary: DavidAU/Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion-735-882-Heretic-Uncensored-NEO-CODER-MAX-MTP-GGUF, developed by DavidAU, is an open-source artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and textual inputs. Optimized to run on consumer-grade hardware, this multi-stage model was trained using Unsloth.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. The strongest, smartest open source multi-stage model fine tune for consumer hardware ever and BUILT on consumer hardware via Unsloth.

items.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face presents a system called MixUA that manages memory sharing in multi-user and multi-agent environments. This system determines which information should be shared and which should remain private during interactions between users and various artificial intelligence agents, ensuring the secure transfer of experiences.

snapshot.description: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. items.title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
items.summary: EgoX is a learning framework that aims to develop general manipulation policies by combining data from robots with different physical structures, humans, and simulated agents into a common framework. This method maps observation and action forms at a semantic level to resolve incompatibilities between different body structures and control interfaces.

snapshot.description: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. EgoX pretrains a Modularized Cross-Embodiment Tra

items.title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
items.summary: The article 'Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space', shared by Hugging Face, introduces the PixVid method, which allows video generation models to operate directly in pixel space instead of compressed latent space. This approach aims to overcome the limitations that existing models face in high-resolution and interactive generation processes.

snapshot.description: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to dire

items.title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
items.summary: 'Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes' examines the performance of reference-frame stabilization methods in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) videos against moving objects. The study presents a two-stage benchmark to identify situations where vehicle movements in urban scenes lead to mismatches.

snapshot.description: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. items.title: TurtLES: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Turbulent 3D Neural PDE Surrogates
items.summary: TurtLES is a large-scale dataset prepared for artificial intelligence models developed to accelerate computational fluid dynamics processes. Containing 3D turbulent flows, this study allows for the training of models with realistic and time-dependent data.

snapshot.description: Machine-learning surrogates are increasingly used to accelerate computational fluid dynamics, yet progress is limited by the lack of benchmarks capturing realistic, time-dependent turbulent flows. We introduce TurtLES, a 14 TB dataset of 3D turbulent cylinder wakes in the shear-layer transition regime, computed via high-fidelity implicit large-eddy simulations. glossary.explanation: A set of accepted methods to achieve the most efficient and error-free result in a field.
A communication infrastructure that allows artificial intelligence assistants to connect to different data sources and tools in a standard way.
Artificial intelligence models trained on massive data that can understand human language and generate text.
A type of software whose source code is open for anyone to inspect, modify, and improve.
A set of tools and libraries that make it easier for developers to build applications for a specific platform or system.
The software component that enables a trained artificial intelligence model to make predictions on new data.
An intermediary server that acts as a bridge between the client and the target server, managing or monitoring traffic.
The smallest unit of data, corresponding to words or character fragments, used by artificial intelligence models when processing text.
The installation and operation of software on the user's own server without receiving external services.
The process of making low-resolution images clearer and higher resolution with the help of artificial intelligence.
Compact computers where the processor, memory, and input/output units are placed on a single circuit board.
A specialized hardware unit designed to perform intensive operations such as graphics processing and artificial intelligence calculations quickly.
An attempt by companies to artificially inflate sales figures or prices by indirectly financing their own products.
The process of artificial intelligence generating meaningful texts in accordance with given commands.
Retraining a pre-trained artificial intelligence model with small datasets to make it more specialized in a specific subject.
Artificial intelligence technology that analyzes written commands and generates images accordingly.
